platforms.name: Whop Content Rewards
onboarding_steps: Sign up at whop.com and verify email + payout method
Open Content Rewards marketplace and filter for Gaming / Streamer clips
Link your YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram accounts via profile/bio verification
Read the campaign brief (max length, required tags, allowed platforms) before cutting
platforms.notes: Largest public Content Rewards marketplace; zero follower minimum on most campaigns.

platforms.name: Clipur
onboarding_steps: Apply via clipur.com and join the Clipur Discord/Whop hub
Submit 1-2 sample vertical edits (use your best GTA 6 stacked clips)
Connect social handles and claim open creator briefs
platforms.notes: Vetted creator distribution network; rewards clean facecam + captions + high retention.

platforms.name: Clipster
onboarding_steps: Create an account on clipster.com (or via Clipster Whop hub)
Verify your TikTok / IG / Shorts pages in the creator dashboard
Pick active streamer campaigns and submit live URLs within the brief window
platforms.notes: Strong streamer-clipping focus with frequent Twitch/YouTube gaming pools.

platforms.name: ClipStake
onboarding_steps: Register on app.clipstake.com / clipstake.com
Connect your posting accounts for automated verified-view tracking
Join open CPM campaigns and submit live Short/Reel links
platforms.notes: Data-backed CPM campaign tracker with clear per-clip view caps and verified analytics.

platforms.name: DareBay
onboarding_steps: Create a DareBay account at darebay.com
Verify your social handles and check active clipping bounties
Post compliant clips and submit post URLs before bounty pool closes
platforms.notes: Wallet-backed clipping bounties and view-based contests.

platforms.name: Vues
onboarding_steps: Sign up at vues.app and verify your email
Link your YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels channels
Enroll in active CPM campaigns and paste live clip links after posting
platforms.notes: Self-serve automated view tracking across Shorts, TikTok, and Reels.

platforms.name: Clipping.io
onboarding_steps: Register at clipping.io and complete profile verification
Review active campaigns and check per-1,000 view rates + geo rules
Submit live URLs immediately after posting so 30-day tracking starts early
platforms.notes: Structured campaign portal with clear view thresholds and tracking windows.

platforms.name: Clipfy
onboarding_steps: Create an account at clipfy.app
Connect your Shorts / TikTok / IG pages
Join gaming/creator briefs and submit your posted clip links
platforms.notes: Creator clipping marketplace for short-form gaming and entertainment campaigns.

platforms.name: Clippers HQ
onboarding_steps: Sign up at clipershq.com and join their Discord community
Follow strictly one account per person and verify your social pages
Claim open campaigns and submit compliant clips
platforms.notes: Strict anti-bot & single-account enforcement (~9.5% fee); consistent gaming briefs.

platforms.name: Clipping.exe
onboarding_steps: Apply or sign up via clip.tech
Complete creator onboarding and connect social handles
Pick active gaming campaigns and submit live links
platforms.notes: Agency-style campaign network with higher CPMs on vetted channels.

platforms.name: Starlet
onboarding_steps: Sign up at starlet.gg and link your gaming channels
Browse gaming creator campaigns and check VOD links/rules
Cut with stream-clipper, post, and submit links in Starlet
platforms.notes: Gaming-native clipping platform ideal for GTA 6 and broader gaming campaigns.
